title: ranunculus paludosus subsp. millefoliatus
intro: Ranunculus paludosus subsp. millefoliatus, commonly known as Marsh Buttercup, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage.
